description: Arpeggiator and step sequencer in one: held polyphonic notes are arpeggiated on an incoming clock, while four drawn sequences add gate length, transposition and two modulation outputs

params.text: When on, the held notes keep playing after the gates are released, until new notes arrive
When on, the arpeggio runs whether or not gates are held
Sets the clock division of the arpeggio, from a division by eight through unity to a multiplication by eight
Attenuates and inverts the RATE CV, -1 to 1
Picks the order the held notes are played in: as played, forwards, backwards, pendulum or random, and the second five repeat each note twice
Attenuates and inverts the SHAPE CV, -1 to 1
Sets how many times round the sequence before that step's value is applied, 1 to 16

inputs.text: The notes to arpeggiate, one per polyphonic channel, read as a volt per octave
The gates that say which notes are held, one per polyphonic channel
The clock the arpeggio runs on; the gate length is worked out from the time between two rising edges
A rising edge returns the arpeggio and all four sequences to their first step
Adds to the clock division after its attenuverter, the range chosen on the menu
Adds to the note order after its attenuverter, the range chosen on the menu

outputs.text: The note being played, as a volt per octave, with the transposition sequence added and quantized if the menu says so
A 10V gate whose length is set by the gate sequence, from nothing to the full step
The first modulation sequence, in the range and polarity set for it, with the slew set for it
The second modulation sequence, in the range and polarity set for it, with the slew set for it
A 10V trigger whenever a step passes its chance roll, on the sequence chosen in the menu
A 10V trigger whenever a cycle counter reaches zero, on the sequence chosen in the menu

notes: the display holds four pages, Gate, Transpose, Mod 1 and Mod 2, each with a row of drawn values, a percentage row setting the chance that the step is applied, and the row of cycle selectors
nothing is played until polyphonic notes and gates are patched in and a clock is patched into CLOCK
a drawn value row carries its own right-click menu, with Shift Left, Shift Right, Randomize, Reverse, Shuffle, Invert, Sort, Mirror, Reset to Default, Zero, Undo and Redo
drag across a value row to draw it, double-click a step to return it to its default, and hold shift while dragging to move the whole row sideways
menu: Probability Output Settings — holds Source, choosing which of the four sequences the PROB output follows, and Trigger Length
Cycle Output Settings — holds Source, choosing which of the four sequences the CYCLE output follows, and Trigger Length
Quantize Output Settings — holds Enable, turning quantizing of the pitch output on, and Scale and Root Note
Rate Attenuverter Response — -5V to +5V or -10V to +10V, setting the span the RATE CV is read over
Reset Cycles — on a cycle selector's own right-click menu, not the panel menu: returns every cycle counter to the start
Legacy Reset Mode — accepts clock pulses immediately after a reset instead of ignoring them briefly
Shape Attenuverter Response — -5V to +5V or -10V to +10V, setting the span the SHAPE CV is read over
Smart Randomize — on a cycle selector's own right-click menu, not the panel menu: fills the cycle selectors with values that fit the sequence

inputs.2: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
